name: Nadiral-Threnody
description: The crust never rests here. Rivers of incandescent basalt vein the lowlands, ash climbs from vents along every fault, and beyond towering mountain ranges the sky stays the color of a bruise.

Light is the weather here. It swings from merciful to murderous within an hour, and everyone schedules their lives around it. Remnant spores persist in sheltered niches, a biosphere's last stubborn embers, awaiting conditions that may never return.
Instruments disagree about radiation hotspot: mass reads one value, inertia another. Probes sent in return transmitting their own launch signals, timestamped hours early.
Whoever controls copper controls the approach lanes. Three factions have done the arithmetic, and only two of them are being subtle about it.
